title: India just approved funding to build its own lithium and nickel processing plants
sources: PMIndia, November 4, 2026 - Cabinet approves Capex Support Scheme to Promote Critical Mineral Processing
Inc42, November 2026 - Cabinet clears Rs 2,814 Cr scheme to boost lithium, nickel processing
caption:
Every EV battery needs processed lithium and nickel. India barely processes any of it domestically - that's starting to change.

The Union Cabinet approved a Rs 2,814 crore scheme to build domestic lithium and nickel processing plants over five years. The scheme funds four new plants - two for lithium, two for nickel - with the government covering 30% of the capital cost through competitive bidding.

The goal is cutting India's reliance on imported refined critical minerals - the raw material bottleneck behind EVs, batteries and renewable energy.

You can build all the EV factories you want. But someone still has to process the minerals that go inside the battery.
